metadata.title: LSS-GAC - A LAMOST Spectroscopic Survey of the Galactic Anti-center

notes: No eligible stars. The paper discusses the LSS-GAC survey and generic prospects for finding rare objects such as hyper-velocity stars (T:p1-b5, T:p5-b2), but it does not identify any specific star as a Galactic unbound candidate or study a previously identified one.
